steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each day's standup is placed in the sprint.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 blocker has been open for three days

findings.title: Note with no progress and no blocker

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] standup-wed:12  Blocker open for three days.
       Fix: Escalate the blocker today.
[medium] standup-tue:19  Blocker with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] standup-notes:26  Note with no progress and no blocker.
       Fix: Record progress or the blocker.
Not checked: Progress not in the notes.
pros: Checks a blocker with no owner, a blocker open for three days, and a note with no progress and no blocker.
cons: Not checked: Progress not in the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-standup-summary skill on the records for this review.
